stories.title: Sources: LSU leaves ex-pros off roster for opener
stories.summary: Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris, who were cleared earlier this week to return to college football after brief stints in the NFL, have not been added to LSU's roster for Saturday's home game against Clemson, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Williams sisters reunite, thrill NY crowd in 3-set loss
stories.summary: Serena and Venus Williams are out of the US Open women's doubles after losing to Hao-Ching Chan and Maya Joint in a third-set tiebreaker.

stories.title: Red Sox, O's skirmish after Alexander's hard slide
stories.summary: The Baltimore Orioles and Boston Red Sox benches cleared after a tense moment involving Blaze Alexander.

stories.title: Mensah, Toney shatter Canes records in blowout
stories.summary: Miami's Malachi Toney started his sophomore campaign in electric fashion, delivering 12 catches for a school-record 234 yards and three touchdowns to lead the Hurricanes to a 45-6 blowout of Stanford.

stories.title: TRO paves way for Daley, Wyatt to return to IU
stories.summary: An Indiana circuit court judge issued a temporary restraining order Friday that clears the way for defensive linemen Stephen Daley and Kellan Wyatt to return to the Hoosiers this season.
